senses.gloss: m. (ζητητός or ζητευτός, sub. θανεῖν, cmp. Tobit I, 19, a. מתבקש Taan. 29ᵃ) one who is sought for to be put to death, a fugitive from justice, outlaw.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite>, beg.; s. 38, beg.; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 631">Yalk. Ps. 631</cite> <cite ref="G00259"><he>זיאטטווס</he></cite>; Ar. ed. Koh. <he>זיטייטוס</he>, Var. <he>זיטויט׳</he>, <he>זיטיט׳</he>) <he>עשה אותו ז׳</he> declare him an outlaw, and he will be like (legally) dead &c.
